image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a custom chrome alloy wheel mounted on a black vehicle. The wheel features a multi-spoke design with a polished finish and a central orange emblem. A black rubber tire with visible tread and sidewall lettering surrounds the rim. The background shows reflections on the glossy black car body and a tiled floor.

The reflections on the chrome spokes are somewhat inconsistent and 'muddy' compared to the sharp reflections on the car body, suggesting slight generative ambiguity in complex reflective surfaces.
Some connections between the inner spokes and the outer rim appear slightly soft or fused, lacking the crisp mechanical separation expected in high-quality CAD renders or photos.
